number: 第二百四十八条の四の二十九
heading_en: Sensitivities, etc. of Commodity Delta and Vega Risk Factors
summary_ja: コモディティのデルタ・リスク・ファクターはスポット価格の相対変化、ベガ・リスク・ファクターはボラティリティの相対変化とし、リスク・ウェイトを定める。
summary_en: Commodity delta risk factors are relative changes in spot prices and vega risk factors are relative changes in volatilities across a bucket; the delta risk weights are set by bucket and the vega risk weight is 100%.
paragraphs: The delta risk factor relating to commodities shall be the relative change in the spot prices of all commodities in the bucket.

The "relative change in the spot prices of commodities" in the preceding paragraph means the value obtained by dividing the change in the value of CVA or of a CVA hedging instrument when the spot prices of all commodities in the bucket are changed simultaneously by 1% in relative terms relative to their present values by 0.01.

The risk weight RW_{k} of the risk factor provided in paragraph (1) shall be as set out in the following table, according to the bucket number (meaning the bucket number classified under paragraph (1) of the preceding Article). {{T:p299t0}}
The vega risk factor relating to commodities shall be the relative change in the volatilities of all commodities in the bucket.

The "relative change in the volatilities of commodities" in the preceding paragraph means the value obtained by dividing the change in the value of CVA or of a CVA hedging instrument when all volatilities relating to all commodities in the bucket are changed simultaneously by 1% in relative terms relative to their present values by 0.01.
The risk weight RW_{k} of the risk factor provided in paragraph (4) shall be 100%.
